• FY27 Q3 Closed Won renewals (is_renewal = TRUE), excl. INVENTORYPARENT
• New / specialist-relevant products only (AIM/360, AM, CN, Fleet Apps, AT, ST, R&D-led lines)
• ACV field: acv_total_price_bookings_usd_converted (gross product)
How we identify net-new on a renewal shell
1. Compare renewal product qty vs prior Closed Won qty on the same account + same product_line (close before this renewal).
2. Incremental qty = opp_qty − prior_qty.
3. Recommended rule: count only when incremental qty > 10 (drops micro-uplifts like River Run / ILIF-style noise).
4. Net-business NNACV = product_acv × (incr_qty / opp_qty).
Smart Trailers conversions (PE / UE / AT → ST)
• Flag when prior PE/UE/AT license_end is within ±90 days of ST close AND source qty ≥ 50% of ST qty.
• Upper-bound reporting: count full ST product ACV as accretive (shown in Summary with “of which” breakout).
• Policy note: license upgrades credit original ACV to Renewal AE; NB AE gets price uplift only — uplift-only not yet computed.
• Conservative path (excl. conversions) is available in the Opportunities “counted” flag / rationale.
Specialist mapping
• Account owner (generalist AE) employee_id × product → specialist_mainline_ae_mapping for FY27 Q3.
• AIM + 360 mapping covers AI Multicam and 360 Visibility.
• Unmapped = no specialist seat mapped to that generalist × product for the quarter.
People fields on Opportunities tab
• Renewal SE = opportunity owner (typically Renewals).
• Generalist AE = account owner.
• Specialist AE = mapped specialist for that product (blank if unmapped).
Column definitions (Opportunities)
• NNACV (product on renewal) = full product ACV sitting on the renewal shell.
• Net-business NNACV = incremental portion counted as new business under the >10 rule (incl. ST conversions at full ACV).
• Split New / Split Renewal = SFDC reverse-churn split fields when Renewal Ops has already applied a split.
• Rationale = why the row is (or is not) treated as new business.
What this is NOT
• Not Xactly / commission payout. Not PSS pacing credit (PSS still excludes is_renewal = TRUE today).
• Reverse Churn form still required for official AE/specialist credit splits.
